title: Identical Linked Lists
description:
[Source: GFG Classic]
Given two Singly Linked List of N and M nodes respectively. The task is to check whether two linked lists are identical or not. Two Linked Lists are identical when they have same data and with same arrangement.

Input Format:
First line: n m
Second line: l1 values
Third line: l2 values

Output Format:
true or false
